description: Lists all of Managed Nerds' downloadable guides as JSON: for each, its id, title, who it's for, what it covers, its page and the email subject to request it. Prices and plans are only inside the guides. Our services are listed by list_services and blog posts are found with search_site. A guide is obtained through the form on its page, or by email to guides@managednerds.ai from the user's own mailbox naming it.
name: list_guides

outputSchema.description: The downloadable guides and how to get one

page.description: Page where a person requests it

title: List guides
